crossRefs.note: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount…
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves…
Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal…
Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people who were with…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.
translations.bsb: Then Samuel set out from Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin. And Saul numbered the troops who were with him, about six hundred men.
translations.kjv: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
translations.asv: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
